newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish oil group seeks privatisation adviser.
newsitem.headline: Polish oil group seeks privatisation adviser.

text.p: Poland's oil holding Nafta Polska SA announced a tender for a privatisation adviser to advise it in the sale of oil refineries Petrochemia Plock SA and Rafineria Gdansk SA, Nafta said on Monday.
Nafta invited investment banks or banking consortia to submit bids by April 21 and said the tender would be carried out in two stages.
Last month Nafta sent information on its privatisation plans to more than 20 international oil firms which have until March 31 to express their interest in the process.

Under the privatisation scheme Nafta Polska, created last year to modernise and privatise the country's oil sector, would offer up to 30 percent of shares in the country's largest refineries to strategic investors, possibly this year.
The buyers would be allowed to increase their stakes in the refineries to over 50 percent after investing in the modernisation of the companies.
